title: laptop battery reading and time left

clauses.text: the battery's percent, status, adapter state, health, cycles and time left or until full are shown, and a desktop or Mac mini shows no battery

steps.do: On the laptop on battery, open the Devices popover (F8) and read the battery facts.
steps.expect: The percent, the status in plain words, the adapter state and the health are shown, and the time left is only shown when it looks believable.

steps.do: Plug the adapter in and read the facts again.
steps.expect: The adapter state shows the adapter, and the status changes to charging or full.
